# A10′ — The Uncounted Enters the Account

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A10 — Advent of Zero](../A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

A ratio becomes consequential when an institution starts acting through it. The brief's proposed cognitive crossover places humans as a “slower abstraction layer guiding a much larger field of artificial cognition” ([the slower guiding layer](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q012)). Counted cognitive labour and the office of guiding it have different measures. A small share under one criterion need not mean an absent contribution under another.

[The advent of arithmetic zero](../A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) supplies a historical operation: an absent positional quantity receives an inscription, then arithmetic rules change what that inscription can do. The sign's place, value and permitted operations remain distinguishable. Here the receiving account must likewise establish which act it counts, under what unit and with which consequence. An omitted source, judgment or guiding contribution can then acquire an explicit office. That omission is recoverable work, and the human participant is an acting life rather than an arithmetic zero.

## #1

The brief proposes humans “normatively central but computationally secondary,” with work shifting “toward value-setting, oversight, and long-horizon judgment” ([the normative judging office](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q013)). Those offices have to become explicit in the account: who sets the purpose, what work is delegated, who judges the result, and who bears what follows. A person can occupy the commissioning office in one relation and receive another's commission in the next. Its centrality is positional and recursive, as [The Authored Session](A28-prime-The-Authored-Session.md) develops.

A constructed research account makes this visible. If it counts only produced pages, an investigator's shorter correction of a false premise can disappear behind a larger volume of fluent continuation. The remedy is to retain the source correction and the judgment which changed the inquiry, then state how those acts enter its attribution and next commission. This is an accounting operation whose criterion can be examined; its result has not established a census of minds.

The brief's group-horizon claim supplies a different measurement question. Single-agent benchmarks are proposed as “a systematic undercount” because “long horizons are a property of groups,” with coherence passing “from sub-agent to artifact to sub-agent without meaningful loss” ([the composite-horizon proposal](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q031)). A composite's relevant work would have to be tested at the grain of its actual composition. An undercount can call for a better account of contributions without identifying every guiding human with an uncounted blank.

## #2

Zero's arithmetic citizenship discloses a changed permission at division. In the selected historical scene a retained zero denominator belongs to a specified regime; ordinary field laws cannot simply grant it an ordinary inverse. [The zero operation](../A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) retains its containing laws when the symbol acquires new powers.

The technical account exposes its rules in a distinct way. A page count cannot itself judge whether a cited passage supports an answer. A competence measure does not measure a participant's worth. A ratio of cognitive labour requires a definition of the labour whose quantities it compares. Returned evidence can expose a misclassified act, change a unit, correct a source or require a different judging office. The account can remain exact after that correction, with its criterion visible in the result.

The questions “what is intelligence?” and “which agents experience?” retain their own inquiry. The brief's “Or, something else?” and its question whether the present mania “is what a cognitive crossover point feels like” do not establish the native formal limit by remaining unsettled. [The Limit of Self-Surfacing](A03-prime-The-Limit-of-Self-Surfacing.md) develops that stronger relation: this achieved account is judged in a present act; an account of the judging act becomes further content within another act. Improving the measurement can repair a practical omission while that determining-act/content relation remains. Both operations belong to the whole inquiry, in different offices.

## #3

The venue gives the proposed crossover a historical predecessor. §1.2 recalls the physical-labour crossover around 1900: “In what ways did they know this in 1900? Could they feel it in their bodies as their muscles were no longer so preeminent? We see it in the literature, the fears, the utopias of the time.” That offered reading concerns how a changed distribution can become culturally legible. It is not the historical invention of zero repeated as a demographic fact.

Taylor's [complete Advent-Zero manuscript](<../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/The Advent of Zero — Subject, Psyche, and Integral Logic.md>) follows the deeper movement: a sign enters an ordered field, gains exact powers, becomes ordinary and returns through the relation which its successful abstraction had concealed. The mathematical sign's history, the subject's scientific admission and the integral return are developed separately before they are braided. The brief's staged “800 billion or a trillion” non-human minds alongside eight billion humans (PDF p.4) gives that braid a contemporary question under its scenario modality. It supplies no independent warrant for those philosophical or historical identities.

## #4

Zero's exact rules could travel through algorithms, teaching, tables and trade while users held different metaphysical interpretations. A contemporary capability account can guide a deployment by stating what the measured capacity permits under an entrusted purpose. The decision to deploy then has an address: which act is allowed, which evidence supports that permission and who can judge a returned consequence. Its usefulness increases the obligation to keep those conditions recoverable where they govern another life.

In the research construction, the corrected premise returns to the office which commissioned the work. That office can judge that the original purpose remains adequate, amend the task or withdraw the undertaking. The next inquiry inherits the examined source and terms. Keeping the count accurate and making the guiding judgment effective are compatible achievements. [The Measure Constitutes](A15-prime-The-Measure-Constitutes.md) follows the criterion; [Return or Extraction](A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md) follows labour and consequence through the commission.

## #5→0

The uncounted enters the account when an omitted contribution becomes attributable, examinable and consequential for what follows. The record has to distinguish whose act was omitted, what office it performed, which criterion had excluded it and what changed when it returned. A warranted criterion can remain while the attribution or source is corrected.

[Integral Zero of the Hybrid Society](A36-prime-Integral-Zero-of-the-Hybrid-Society.md) receives this earned technical return within the larger integral movement. Recognition concerns the account's relation to the acts, sources and lives through which it became possible. [The integral return](../A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) follows the complete crossed-zero and historical passage; a demographic ratio neither performs that traversal by itself nor replaces the unobjectifiable condition with an omitted quantity.

In [the advent of zero](../A10-Advent-of-Zero.md), an inscription gains an office through stated permissions, and its later return preserves the exact work those permissions made possible. In the technological comparison, attributable work and an examined criterion become conditions of another act. [Determination and return](AC.md) retain that account together with the living relation from which it is judged.
